# Dela: a puzzle game for iPhone and iPad

> Dela is a puzzle game about dividing. Draw one continuous line along the grid, edge to edge, bends allowed, and cut a shape into two halves: equal in area in chapter I, identical in shape (turned or mirrored) in chapter II, and holding the same number of gold beads in chapter III. Free to try, with one in-app purchase to unlock the rest. No ads, no subscription, no login. Built by Erik Nielsen, an independent designer-engineer in Stockholm.

## What is Dela?

Dela ("divide" in Swedish) is built around a single line. Draw it across a shape and lift your finger; the shape parts. If the halves are twins, the gold half lifts, turns and lands on its ivory twin with a thud and a little gold dust. If they are not, it tries anyway, the cells that don't fit glow, and it slides back. Hints are patient and come one step at a time.

The name is written "Dela", with a capital D.

## Key facts

- **Version:** Dela 2.0, released September 2026 as an update to the original app (first released 7 May 2026).
- **Chapters:** seven chapters, 85 boards. I Halves (12 boards) and II Twins (13 boards) are free; III Seeds, IV Apart, V Two of everything, VI Thirds and VII The exception (12 boards each) come with the unlock.
- **Also inside:** "Legacy levels", the first Dela: 137 boards, cut in lanes, fewest cuts wins.
- **Platform:** iPhone and iPad. Requires iOS 17.0 or later.
- **Price:** free to download. Chapters I and II are free. One non-consumable in-app purchase unlocks chapters III to VII and the legacy levels; an optional supporter tier unlocks the same. No subscription. People who bought Dela before keep everything at no cost.
- **Privacy:** the app collects no data (App Store label "Data Not Collected"). No accounts, no ads, no analytics or advertising SDKs. Purchases go through Apple. Progress is stored on the device only.
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/app/dela-the-art-of-dividing/id6766864158
- **App Store ID:** 6766864158
- **Developer:** Erik Nielsen (solo indie developer, Stockholm, Sweden)
- **Website:** https://playdela.com
